arrangement.title: Original screenshot contours and rhythmic taps
decisions: The accepted full 70 BPM preview is imported exactly: 58 presses with 26 continuous bend holds, preserving all 135 reconstructed pitch targets.
Each live event references its approved arrangement event ID. Screenshot note IDs and exact target beats are retained; historical MIDI and normalized inventory are unchanged.
Natural rises and falls use continuous bends. Repeated accents remain separate. Tutorial boundaries follow the screenshot timing and never cut a held gesture.
The existing ten-Honk layout is preserved. Either hand can play; all bends within one hold use one Trigger press.
Every sound uses the ordinary Honk instrument, voice engine, vowel, gain, envelope, and mixer. Only tuning, note timing and wrist bend are guided; preview audio and synthesis are not loaded.
The original MIDI was reconstructed from the user's edited GarageBand screenshots; its timing remains approximate relative to that visual source.

lessons.title: Opening pulses and first turn
lessons.goal: Keep the opening taps distinct. Hold C♯ through the rising and falling turn. Follow each held bend, then keep the final C♯ pressed as it bends down through B to A.

lessons.title: Low pulses and answering phrase
lessons.goal: Keep the low repeated pulses crisp. Hold F♯ through the descent to E and E♭. Keep C♯ held through the answering bends, and use one final hold for the descent through B to A.

lessons.title: High repeated notes and the crest
lessons.goal: Keep the high repeated notes distinct. Hold G♯ through F♯ and back to G♯, then hold A through the crest at B and the descent to F♯.

lessons.title: Fast turns with fewer presses
lessons.goal: Hold E as it bends up through F♯ to G♯, then keep the repeated G♯ taps distinct. Use one press for each following bend phrase, staying held through every turn and return to neutral.

lessons.title: Answer and return
lessons.goal: Follow the falling and rising turns with continuous holds. Do not press again within a bend phrase. Keep the returning E pulses distinct.

lessons.title: Rising and falling holds
lessons.goal: Hold through each quick turn and keep the repeated E accents distinct. Keep the final E held through all its rising and falling bends to C♯.

lessons.title: Closing phrase
lessons.goal: Hold the opening C♯ through the answering bends. Use one hold for the C♯ to B to A descent, preserve the low pulses, and hold the final F♯ through E to E♭ before the two C♯ presses.

lessons.title: Complete guided performance
lessons.goal: Play the whole section at 70 BPM. Keep Trigger held through each complete bend phrase, including every turn and return to neutral. Release only between separate notes and preserve the repeated rhythmic taps. Either hand works.

recording.instructions: Play at 70 BPM. Follow the squares for each new press. When the bend gauge appears, keep Trigger held through the entire bend phrase and every return to neutral. Release between separate notes and preserve repeated accents. Either hand works.
